ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Welfare and Daycare Fraud Network
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged welfare and daycare fraud in Minnesota, following the money and identifying key players
questions: Who are the key players involved?
How did the alleged fraud occur?
What is the extent of the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and identify key players involved. Further investigation is warranted to follow the money and understand the extent of the alleged fraud.
